title: Life's What Happens
style: Candy pop, clean production with airy vocal layers; a light, bouncing midtempo groove; female vocals in a low, dark lower register, breathy and close in the verses, opening into doubled choruses; plucked keyboards and rounded 808 bass, with a pared-back outro.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A sunny day making the room warm,
a chilly afternoon yesterday
followed by showers and rain—
umbrellas, hoodies, or getting wet.

[Pre-Chorus]
Life’s what happens
while you complain.

[Chorus]
Little moments, little frictions,
mishaps, and joys,
reality or fiction.

[Verse 2]
A walk to the store for milk or eggs,
leaving late from the office, busy night,
having agents doing your job,
spending your weekend correcting both.

[Pre-Chorus]
Life’s what happens
while you daydream.

[Chorus]
Little moments, little frictions,
mishaps, and joys,
reality or fiction.

[Verse 3]
The news cycle revealing the world,
the notable exceptions, newsworthy enough,
new trendings in social media,
people doing stuff for which you’re too old.

[Pre-Chorus]
Life’s what happens
while coffee brews.

[Chorus]
Little moments, little frictions,
mishaps, and joys,
reality or fiction.

[Verse 4]
The people you like living their lives,
the sun through the window at your job,
the cat demands attention during the meeting—
they say it’s cute,
you remove its hair off your mouth.

[Pre-Chorus]
Life’s what happens
while enduring through.

[Chorus]
Little moments, little frictions,
mishaps, and joys,
reality or fiction.

[Outro]
Life's what happens
while you listen.
